Subject: Novablade POC kickoff — proposed July 22 (onsite vs virtual)

Hi Oliver / Nora,

Thanks again for the quick intake call last week — excited to get the POC kicked off. Proposed plan below: a half-day hands-on workshop focused on prompt review, routing configuration, and a short load test on live traffic patterns.

Proposed slot: Wednesday, July 22, 09:30–13:00 (Novablade HQ or hybrid).

Quick logistics questions so we can finalize:
- Do you prefer onsite at your SF office or a virtual / hybrid session?
- If onsite: can guests get same-day visitor badges? Any sign-in steps we should prep?
- AV/recording: will it be OK if we record the session for internal engineering follow-ups?
- For load tests: can you share expected concurrent request counts and a sample prompt list (we can also use the draft agenda prompts attached)?

I've attached a draft agenda and the site floorplan to help with room sizing. Dev (cc) will run routing/load test configuration; Evelyn (ops) will need to confirm recording permissions if onsite.

Next steps: if July 22 works, I'll send the calendar invite and Zoom link. If not, propose an alternate date and time.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: agenda-draft.md, novablade-site-floorplan.pdf

Subject: Re: Novablade POC kickoff — proposed July 22 (onsite vs virtual)

Hi Camila,

Thanks — we should definitely do this. One conflict popped up on our exec calendar and we need to move the kickoff one day later to Thursday, July 23. Same morning window would be ideal (09:30–13:00).

Onsite is preferred so our product and infra teams can join in person. A couple of quick items for your planning:
- Room capacity: we can accommodate up to ~20 people in Conference B (floorplan attached to internal thread).
- Visitor badges: Facilities needs a pre-submitted guest list by EOD Wednesday to print badges in advance.
- Recording: fine on our side pending internal sign-off from Security; I’ll loop Nora (security ops) and Facilities on logistics.

Nora — can you confirm whether same-day badges are possible if we miss the EOD deadline?

Oliver
Senior Director, Platform Engineering
Novablade Inc.

On our side:
- We will provide a Zoom link and a live caption option for remote participants.
- Dev will run routing + load tests at the end of the session for ~5 minutes; can you confirm expected concurrent sessions (approx. 10–15?) and whether test traffic should originate from our hosted endpoint or inside your network?

Subject: Re: Novablade POC kickoff — routing/load test questions

Nice to meet you virtually, Oliver — quick technical Qs so we can size the routing/load rehearsal:
- Target concurrent sessions: will you want us to simulate 10, 25, or 50 concurrent user sessions?
- Typical prompt sizes: average token length (short ~50 tokens, medium ~150, long ~300)?
- Are there any IP allowlists or egress restrictions we should know about if we originate traffic from Redwood-hosted load generators?

Plan is to run a 5-minute continuous routing test at the end of the workshop that exercises the recommended batching/quantization profile and our fallback policy. If you can push back numbers today/tomorrow, I’ll draft the exact commands and will share the load script before the session.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
